fusions.name: Strip the Field
fusions.desc: Leaps at a target up to 5 tiles away for 7 damage, up to 1.4 times that at full reach, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Grain Thieves
fusions.desc: Sends 4 snapping jaws out in a spread, each of which deals 3 wind damage.

fusions.name: Hunger of the Cloud
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds. While it lasts, an escort of locusts fights beside you, striking for 3 every 1.4s.

fusions.name: Left Nothing
fusions.desc: When you kill something, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
